title: عرض أطفالك ويومهم كجهة اتصال عائلية
body:
**الجمهور:** جهة اتصال عائلية (وصي/جد). **المتطلبات:** أنشأ المركز حساباً لك بعلاقة "Family" مع طفل؛ signed in.

1. سجّل الدخول (Sign in) ببريدك الإلكتروني وكلمة المرور. Expected: تصل إلى **أطفالي**.
2. انقر بطاقة طفل. Expected: تفتح تفاصيل الطفل مع حالة الحضور وتقرير اليوم.
3. اقرأ **تحديثات اليوم** و**تقرير اليوم** (المزاج، الإفطار، الغداء، سناك، النوم، الحفّاض).
4. استخدم الشريط الجانبي لفتح **الأخبار**، **الفعاليات**، **التعلّم**، **الملفات المشتركة**، **الاستبيانات**، **الموافقات**، **الدردشة**، **الدعم**.
5. لتغيير اللغة: افتح **الإعدادات**، ثم **إعدادات الحساب**، ثم **لغة التطبيق**، اختر **English** أو **العربية**، ثم انقر **حفظ**.

**ما يمكنك فعله:** يمكنك قراءة كل ما يراه ولي الأمر للطفل. اعتماد الموافقات، إرسال النماذج، الإقرار بالحوادث، وإرسال تذاكر الدعم غير متاحة لجهات الاتصال العائلية.

**Troubleshooting**

- ترى فقط **أطفالي** و**الإعدادات** في الشريط الجانبي: حسابك للاستلام فقط. See "تسجيل حضور طفلك (جهة استلام فقط)".
- تعيد صفحة ما إلى **أطفالي**: تلك الصفحة غير متاحة لحسابك.

**Related:** تغيير لغة التطبيق · اعتماد أو رفض طلب موافقة

title: See your children and their day as a family contact
body:
**Audience:** Family contact (carer / grandparent). **Prerequisites:** your daycare created an account for you with a Family relationship to a child; signed in.

1. Sign in to the portal with your email and password. Expected: you land on **My children**.
2. Click a child's card. Expected: the child detail opens with the check-in status and today's report.
3. Read **Today's updates** and **Today's report** (Mood, Breakfast, Lunch, Snack, Sleep, Diaper).
4. Use the sidebar to open **News feed**, **Events**, **Learning**, **Parent drive**, **Surveys**, **Consents**, **Chat**, and **Support**.
5. To change the language, open **Settings**, then **Account settings**, then **App language**, choose **English** or **العربية**, then click **Save**.

**What you can do:** you can read everything a parent sees for the child. Approving consents, submitting forms, acknowledging incidents, and sending support tickets are not available to family contacts.

**Troubleshooting**

- You see only **My children** and **Settings** in the sidebar: your account is pickup-only. See "Check your child in as a pickup contact".
- A page redirects back to **My children**: that page is not available to your account.

**Related:** Change the app language · Approve or deny a consent request

title: عرض أطفالي وحالة تسجيل حضورهم اليوم
body:
**النسخة الإنجليزية:** [See your children and today's check-in status](https://app.notion.com/p/401b1414845681d6ae33f26bd881ccd2)

**الجمهور:** أولياء الأمور. **المتطلبات:** مسجّل الدخول؛ أنت ولي أمر/وصي مفوّض لطفل واحد على الأقل.

١. سجّل الدخول. تصل إلى صفحة **أطفالي**.
٢. تعرض بطاقة كل طفل اسم الطفل والغرفة وشارة حالة اليوم: **حاضر** (أخضر) أو **منصرف** (رمادي) أو **لم يسجّل الحضور بعد**.

**ملاحظات**

- إذا لم يظهر أي طفل، فقد لا يكون حسابك مرتبطًا بعد. اطلب من الحضانة إرسال رمز دعوة، ثم فعّل حسابك.
- حسابات "الاستلام فقط" ترى صفحة **أطفالي** فحسب.

**ذات صلة:** تسجيل حضور طفلك أو انصرافه · تغيير لغة التطبيق

title: See your children and today's check-in status
body:
**Audience:** Parents. **Prerequisites:** signed in; you are an authorized parent/guardian for at least one child.

title: تسجيل حضور طفلك أو انصرافه
body:
**النسخة الإنجليزية:** [Check your child in or out](https://app.notion.com/p/3fab14148456813a9212c5ac34dd4f35)

**الجمهور:** أولياء الأمور. **المتطلبات:** تسجيل الدخول، وأن تكون وليَّ أمر مصرَّحًا به للطفل.

١. افتح **أطفالي**.

٢. افتح بطاقة طفلك؛ تعرض حالة اليوم — **لم يسجّل الحضور بعد** أو **حاضر**.

٣. اضغط **تسجيل حضور**. النتيجة: تصبح الحالة **حاضر** ويظهر وقت **سجّل الحضور في**.

٤. لإنهاء اليوم اضغط **تسجيل انصراف**. النتيجة: يصبح الطفل منصرفًا ويعود زر **تسجيل حضور**.

**ملاحظات**

- يمكن للمركز تعطيل التسجيل الذاتي. إن لم يظهر زر **تسجيل حضور**/**تسجيل انصراف**، فاطلب من أحد الموظفين تسجيل الحضور.
- يمكن للموظفين تسجيل حضور طفلك من البوابة، وسترى الحالة نفسها.

**ذات صلة:** عرض أطفالك وحالة حضور اليوم · تسجيل الحضور وتسجيل دخول الأطفال

**الكلمات المفتاحية:** تسجيل حضور, تسجيل انصراف, check in, check out

title: Check your child in or out
body:
**Audience:** Parents. **Prerequisites:** signed in; you are an authorized parent/guardian for the child.

1. Open **My children**.
2. Open your child. Their card shows today's status — **Not checked in yet** or **Checked in**.
3. Click **Check in**. Expected: the status becomes **Checked in** and a **Checked in at** time appears.
4. To finish the day, click **Check out**. Expected: the child shows as checked out and **Check in** returns.

**Notes**

- Your center can turn self check-in/off on or off. If you do not see **Check in**/**Check out**, ask a staff member to record attendance.
- Staff can check your child in from the portal; you will see the same status.

**Related:** See your children and today's check-in status · Take attendance and check children in

title: Read today's report and updates for your child
body:
**Audience:** Parents. **Prerequisites:** signed in; authorized for the child.

title: React to or comment on a news feed post
body:
**Audience:** Parents. **Prerequisites:** signed in; authorized for at least one child.

title: إرسال رسالة إلى فريق طفلك
body:

- لا توجد محادثات: لا يستطيع أولياء الأمور بدء محادثة — اطلب من الموظفين مراسلتك أولًا.
- زر الإرسال لا يفعل شيئًا: اكتب رسالة قبل الإرسال.

title: Send a message to your child's staff
body:
**Audience:** Parents. **Prerequisites:** signed in. Your center must have started a conversation with you.

1. Open **Chat** in the sidebar. The page title is **Messages**.
2. Under **Your threads**, open the conversation with your child's team — for example **Chat with {staff name}**. A **Private** thread is only between you and staff; a group thread is shared with everyone in it.
3. Type your message in the box at the bottom.
4. Click **Send**. Expected: your message appears in the thread at the current time, and staff replies appear here too.

**Troubleshooting**

- There are no threads: parents cannot start a conversation — ask staff to message you first.
- The send button does nothing: type a message before sending.

**Related:** Send a support request

title: Reset a forgotten password
body:
**Audience:** Parents, staff, and admins who cannot sign in. **Prerequisites:** the email address on your account.

1. On the sign-in page, click **Forgot your password?**.
2. Expected: the **Reset your password** page opens. Enter your **Email**.
3. Click **Send reset link**. Expected: Kiddy shows **Check your email** — "If an account exists for that address, we sent a password-reset link. The link expires in one hour."
4. Open the email and click the reset link.
5. Expected: the **Set a new password** page opens. Choose and confirm your new password.
6. Return to the sign-in page and sign in with the new password.

**Notes**

- The reset link opens the **Set a new password** page. Opened without a link (or after it expires), the page says: "This page completes a password-reset link. Open the link from your email, or request a new one." with a **Request a reset link** button.
- If Kiddy cannot send a link to the address, it says: "We couldn't send a reset link to that address. If you're a parent or staff member, ask your daycare admin to re-invite you or set a new password." Ask your daycare admin for a new invite code, or to set a password for you.
- The reset link expires after one hour.

**Related:** Sign in to Kiddy · Confirm your email address

title: Confirm your email address
body:
**Audience:** Parents and staff who just activated an account. **Prerequisites:** you received (or need to request) a confirmation email.

1. After you activate your account, you land on the **Confirm your email** page. Expected: it says "Almost there! We sent a confirmation link to your email address. Click it to enable password sign-in to your account."

title: Invite a parent to the portal
body:
**Audience:** Staff & admin. **Prerequisites:** signed in as an admin; the child already has a profile.

- **Title** (مطلوب).
- **Kind** — Form أو Survey أو List / sign-up.
- **Description** (اختياري).

٥. اضغط **Create form**. النتيجة المتوقعة: صف جديد في الجدول مع **Publish** = Draft.

٦. للنشر، اضغط **Publish** (ينشئ رابط مشاركة). النتيجة المتوقعة: **Publish** becomes Live ويظهر رابط ولي الأمر `/forms/f/…`.

٧. لقراءة الردود، اضغط **View submissions**. النتيجة المتوقعة: أعداد المسار وقائمة الردود؛ عيّن حالة كل رد عبر القائمة المنسدلة + **Set**.

- رابط ولي الأمر لا يفتح: اضغط **Regenerate link**.

ملاحظة: تُعرض هذه الشاشة بالإنجليزية في الوضع العربي.

title: Build a smart form
body:
**Audience:** Staff & admin. **Prerequisites:** you are signed in with a staff or admin account.

Forms, surveys, and sign-up lists are built in one place, then published for parents. A form collects submissions you can track through a funnel (New → Viewed → Contacted → Completed → Archived).

1. Open **Smart form** in the sidebar (page title **Forms, lists & surveys**).
2. Click **Build new form** (top right).
3. Fill in:
   - **Title** (required).
   - **Kind** — Form, Survey, or List / sign-up.
   - **Description** (optional).
4. Add questions (up to 3 in this panel): **Question #N**, **Type** (Text / Long text / Choice / Yes/No), **Options** (comma-separated, for Choice), and mark **Required**.
5. Click **Create form**. Expected: a new row appears in the table with **Publish** = Draft.
6. To publish, click **Publish** (generates a share link). Expected: **Publish** becomes Live and a parent link `/forms/f/…` is shown.
7. To read submissions, click **View submissions**. Expected: the funnel counts and the submission list; set each submission's status with the dropdown + **Set**.

**Troubleshooting**

- No forms match: clear the search box, set **Type** to "All types" and **Publish state** to "Any publish state", then click **Apply** (or **Clear**).
- Parent link does not open: click **Regenerate link**.

**Related:** Create a survey and read responses · Read and reply to inquiries

title: Generate an invoice for a child
body:
**Audience:** Staff & admin. **Prerequisites:** you are signed in with an admin account, and the child already has a profile.

A billing record (invoice) charges a payer for one child. Create one from **Finance** or from the child's profile.

1. Open **Children** in the sidebar and open the child.
2. Open the **Invoices** tab, then click **Manage billing**.
3. Under **Add a billing record**, fill in:
   - **Description** — what you are charging for, for example "October tuition".
   - **Amount (CAD)** — the amount to charge.
   - **Period** *(optional)* — the billing period, for example "2026-10".
   - **Due date** *(optional)*.
   - **Currency** — **CAD** or **USD**.
   - **Status** — **Pending**, **Paid**, **Overdue**, or **Cancelled**.
4. Click **Add record**. Expected: the new invoice appears in this child's **Invoices** tab (`0 invoices` counter increases) and on **Finance → Invoices**.

**Troubleshooting**

- The record is missing on **Finance → Invoices**: set the status filter to **All statuses** and click **Apply**.
- The amount currency looks wrong: this form is labelled **Amount (CAD)** while the center totals are in **AED** — confirm the currency with an administrator before invoicing.

**Related:** Record a payment or deposit · Add a child profile

title: Read and send portal messages
body:
**Audience:** Staff & admin. **Prerequisites:** you are signed in with a staff or admin account.

2. Browse conversations/threads in the left column; the unread count and badge are shown.
3. Use the search box to filter by participant name or last message; toggle **Unread** to show only unread.
4. Click a conversation or thread to read it; type a reply and click **Send**.

Send a new message:

1. Click the ✎ button (new message).
2. Select recipients:
   - **Classroom channels** (checkboxes; choose Whole / Children / Staff).
   - **Parents** (checkboxes).
3. Optional: attach a file, or tick **Make it group message**.
4. Type your message and click **Send**.

Errors appear as a banner: "norecipients" (no recipients chosen) or "attachment" (attachment problem).

**Troubleshooting**

- No parents listed: confirm children are enrolled in classrooms with linked parents.
- Attachment failed: remove the file and retry, or check the file size.

2. **App language:** choose the app language in the language card.
3. **Working hours:** set open/close times per day, then click **Save working hours**. (A day with no times is closed; anyone still checked in 3 hours after closing is auto checked-out.)
4. **Center details:** enter **Center name**, **Contact**, **Address**, then click **Save center details**.
5. **Logo & brand image:** upload a logo and a brand image.
6. **Branding:** set **Daycare name**, **Primary color**, **Accent color**, **Font** (Inter / Nunito / Poppins / Georgia), then click **Save branding**. The preview card shows the result.

**Troubleshooting**

- You are redirected to the dashboard: this page is admin-only.

**Related:** Set center working hours · Add a room

title: Add an event
body:
**Audience:** Staff & admin. **Prerequisites:** you are signed in with a staff or admin account.

1. Open **Events** from the Calendar page (Home → Calendar → Events).
2. Under **Add an event**, fill in:
   - **Title** (required).
   - **Date** (required).
   - **Start** and **End** (optional times).
   - **Location** (optional).
   - **Description** (optional).
3. Click **Add event**. Expected: an event card appears with the date badge, time, location, and description.
4. To attach photos/videos, open the event link with `?open=<id>` and use **Attach**.
5. The event also appears on the **Calendar** page for staff.

Parents see upcoming events on their portal.

**Troubleshooting**

- (none observed)

**Related:** See upcoming events and watch videos (parent)
